title: Metal Barrels framed
description: Changed upgraded barrels textures to be framed instead.
body:
This is a resource pack for [_Metal Barrels_](https://modrinth.com/mod/metal-barrels) mod by [**Tfacrenim**](https://modrinth.com/user/Tfarcenim). It changes upgraded barrel textures to be framed, instead of being made whole from a material block.

Below, the comparison:
![Comparison](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7a97c00df819e07779b666f257a358196d38eadc.png)
